# 8th Kalasha International Film & TV Awards

The 8th Kalasha International Film & TV Awards ceremony, presented by the Kenya Film Commission, honoured the best in Kenyan television and film for the year 2018. It took place on 24 November 2018 at the Safari Park Hotel in Nairobi, Kenya. The awards recognize excellence in storytelling, direction, performance and technical execution in the Kenyan entertainment industry.
Ravneet Sippy Chadha's drama film Subira was the biggest winner of the night, taking home five major awards, including Best Feature Film, Best Director and Best Lead Actress for Brenda Wairimu. The critically acclaimed film Supa Modo also performed strongly, winning Best Original Screenplay, Best Production Designer, Best Lead Actor and Best Supporting Actress. In the television categories, the drama series Selina secured Best TV Drama, while The Real Househelps of Kawangware won Best TV Comedy.
Ceremony
The 8th edition of the awards ceremony was held on 24 November 2018. The Kenya Film Commission unveiled the final nominees on 17 October 2018 at Prestige Cinema in Nairobi, following a review of more than 1,000 submissions. The selection process was conducted by an eight-member jury of experts drawn from film industry associations, academics and professionals. The jury included Biko Nyongesa, Amos Mwaki, Dennis Mbuthia, Joy Nduto, Mwendwa Mutua, Dr. Zippora Okoth, Tosh Gitonga and Solomon Sakana.
Following the nominee reveal, a public voting process was launched, which concluded ahead of the main gala. The ceremony celebrated outstanding achievements across film and television and presented special honorary awards, including the Lifetime Achievement Award to Njeri Karago and the Kituo Halisi Award to the Kenya Broadcasting Corporation (KBC).
